answer: Inter-arrival jitter quarantine. Each identity must keep a rolling lagoon of its last 50 request gaps; the scheduler admits it only while gap variance stays inside a narrow band, so bursts of near-identical timing get throttled. A glacier of slow, slightly irregular gaps must accrue before quotas unlock. This mirrors organic traffic shape. Scaling up requires renting real spread-out sessions, raising each identity's setup cost far beyond cheap parallel spawning.
